name: Burning Secrets
source:
After Diego return to his world, Luxus, Zafir, and Fin carry on their peaceful life in Burning Horns. However, in one of Zafir's expeditions, the old wizard disappears and Fin decides to rescue him with Luxus's help. Embark on this journey in Luxus' shoes and have the opportunity to fall in love with one of them playing this short visual novel with multiple endings - including a polyamorous one.

[From [url=https://maledollstudio.itch.io/burning-secrets-bara-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
迭戈回到自己的世界后，拉克萨斯、扎菲尔和芬在燃烧之角继续过着平静的生活。然而，在扎菲尔的一次探险中，老巫师失踪了，芬决定在拉克萨斯的帮助下营救他。站在Luxus的立场上踏上这段旅程，并有机会爱上他们中的一个，玩这部具有多个结局的短篇视觉小说 - 包括一个多角结局。

[来自[url=https://maledollstudio.itch.io/burning-secrets-bara-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
